title: Cloud and AWS fundamentals — quick overview
rememberThis: Cloud = metered IT over the network with elasticity; Regions and AZs provide geographic and fault isolation.
Shared responsibility: AWS secures infrastructure; you secure IAM, network, encryption, and data.
Control plane configures; data plane serves — split IAM permissions accordingly.
Map problems to service categories before naming products; tag everything for cost attribution.
bullets: IaaS (EC2) → you patch OS; PaaS (Lambda) → AWS patches runtime.
CloudTrail logs control plane; S3 access logging or data events for object audit.
Cost surprises: data transfer out, NAT Gateway, idle Elastic IPs, untagged dev.
Request service quota increases before production launch — not during deploy failure.
